verdict.rationale: Sill's public GitHub repository includes build-from-source instructions: building Sill.app with SwiftPM, running `swift run -c release SillHost`, and changing the bundle identifier to your own. That shows the source is publicly readable and buildable. Nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an identified open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache/GPL LICENSE file), independent confirmation of the licensing terms.
